sahneler.metin: In fog on the St. Lawrence River, a collier rammed the liner Empress of Ireland.
In fourteen minutes, the liner rolled over and sank, and one thousand twelve people died.
Unlike Titanic, it carried enough lifeboats.
It sank too fast to launch most of them.
The collier had opened a huge hole in its side.
Water also poured in through open portholes.
The disaster reinforced rules on watertight doors and portholes.

aciklama:
Empress of Ireland sank in minutes after a collision in fog. The cause: a large side breach with open portholes and too little time to close watertight doors.
